items.caption: A seal-script-style form of 休, shown in a modern redraw. It provides a later graphic example but does not resolve the disputed interpretation of the character’s origin.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style strokes form the character 休 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The visible glyph is identifiable as 休, and the cited records identify it as a modern redraw in Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates a later form without establishing the character’s original motivation.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw rather than an independently dated artifact image. The person-and-tree and military marker-post interpretations of 休’s origin remain disputed.
